notes:
Fixes the blank manual update page introduced in preview 5.

The update page now gives its scroll area the available screen height, restoring the release card, update buttons, notes, and progress details.

Includes a regression test for the layout-helper overload that caused the blank screen.
critical_message: This update fixes the blank manual update page introduced in preview 5 and restores access to update controls. Please install Moagram preview 6.
